messages:
maria: Starting EKS bootstrap for eu-central-2. Goal: GPU spot nodegroup for batch inference + small ondemand infra pool for agents and monitoring.
aj: Good. Drop the preflight checklist here so I can verify quotas and SGs.
maria: Preflight checklist: 1) Request ENI & IPv4 quota increases; 2) Create VPC w/ 3 AZ subnets (/24); 3) Approve GPU instance families (p3/p4) in billing console; 4) Prepare eksctl cluster YAML + nodegroup specs; 5) Install NVIDIA operator + device plugin; 6) Tag subnets + cluster for internal ELB; 7) Run driver & infer smoke tests; 8) Handoff to oncall with logs.
devon: Reminder from ap-south incident: ENI limits are often tiny in new regs. Verify ENI-per-instance for chosen instance type: `aws ec2 describe-instance-types --instance-types p4d.24xlarge --query 'InstanceTypes[].NetworkInfo'`. Also check elastic network interface quotas.
aj: I'll file quota ticket (AWS-987654) for ENI and EIP increases and request EFA if needed for NCCL tests.
maria: Nodegroup plan: gpu-spot (capacityType: SPOT, tainted, label role=gpu) + infra-ondemand (small t3/t4 family). Using standard eksctl AMIs for now; Bottlerocket deferred.
samir: How are we installing NVIDIA drivers? Operator or manual daemonset? Operator simplifies upgrades but had issues in v2.
devon: We prefer NVIDIA GPU Operator (current stable). Install flow: `kubectl create ns gpu-operator` then apply operator manifest from the verified tag. Verify pods come up in gpu-operator ns.
aj: Kubelet notes: ensure kubeletExtraArgs include any required feature gates for device plugins and set `--fail-swap-on=false` if using some base AMIs. For maxPods we may want to tune `maxPods` in nodegroup config for p4 nodes.
maria: For spot pool, add label `capacityType=SPOT` and taint `spot=true:PreferNoSchedule` so batch scheduler can tolerate. We'll use PodDisruptionBudgets and retry logic to handle preemptions.
devon: If job consolidation & bin-packing is critical consider Karpenter instead of ASG. Karpenter needs separate IAM role + instance profile and is more flexible for GPU scheduling.
samir: Smoke test snippet: `kubectl run gpu-check --image=nvidia/cuda:11.8-base --rm -it --restart=Never -- nvidia-smi` and then run a lightweight inference container to validate CUDA & cuDNN.
aj: Network gotcha: if we later enable Cilium with tunneling, adjust MTU (e.g., 8951 for jumbo) to prevent packet fragmentation. For now we'll stick with aws-vpc-cni.
maria: Tagging: add `kubernetes.io/cluster/prod-euc2=owned` and proper `k8s.io/role/elb` tags on public subnets.
infra-bot: quota-status: ENI limit 120 for eu-central-2; pending EIP increase.
aj: Security groups: Node SG must allow intra-SG all TCP for kubelet & metrics, 10250 TCP from control plane, and NodePort range if we need it. Lock down SSH.
devon: kube-proxy: stick with iptables mode for stability on our AMIs. IPVS sometimes requires kernel modules that are flaky on custom images.
samir: After nodes report Ready, confirm `kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i nvidia` shows allocatable `nvidia.com/gpu`. Then run NCCL allreduce smoke for multi-GPU health check.
maria: Autoscaling: set cluster-autoscaler annotations for ASG or set Karpenter Provisioner if we go that route. For spot, set mixed-instance-policy if using ASG to diversify.
aj: For eksctl, example nodegroup snippet (we will parameterize):
```
apiVersion: eksctl.io/v1alpha5
kind: ClusterConfig
metadata:
  name: prod-euc2
  region: eu-central-2
nodeGroups:
  - name: gpu-spot
    instanceType: p4d.24xlarge
    minSize: 0
    maxSize: 3
    capacityType: SPOT
    labels: {role: gpu, workload: batch}
    taints: [{key: "spot", value: "true", effect: "PreferNoSchedule"}]
```
We'll adjust instanceType to p3/p4 depending on quota and price.
maria: Logging & observability baseline: fluentd -> S3 for infra logs, node-exporter + prometheus + kube-state-metrics, and dashboard in Grafana for GPU metrics (nvidia-smi exporter).
devon: Run stress test post-driver: 15 minute GPU synthetic load while monitoring GPU temp, power, mem utilization and host-level metrics. Capture traces in Grafana.
aj: Pod networking: watch out for IP exhaustion on p4d if maxPods default high. Consider `maxPods` override per nodegroup or change packing to reduce pod count per node.
samir: Cost note: spot eviction probability for p4 in this region currently estimated ~10%. Recommend fallback policy: have ondemand retry pool or checkpointing in batch jobs.
oncall-sre: I'll take handoff during the window. Please attach smoke logs to the incident ticket when done and ping #eng-oncall.
maria: Schedule: cluster create 2026-03-20T01:00:00Z, driver install & smoke 01:30, validation & handoff by 02:30.
deploy-bot: deploy-schedule: eksctl apply at 2026-03-20T01:00:00Z (ticket AWS-987654).
maria: Will post `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `kubectl get pods -A` + link to smoke logs once finished.
aj: Thanks — will report quota approval here when I hear back.
samir: :rocket: good luck everyone.
oncall-sre: Oncall standing by 01:15-03:00 UTC, will monitor channel and Grafana alerts.
